Lists usages associated with a subscription for a particular metered addon. This will display the previously recorded addons for a subscription.

This endpoint is not compatible with seat-based addons.

## Since Date and Until Date Usage

Note: The `since_date` and `until_date` attributes each default to midnight on the date specified. For example, in order to list usages for January 20th, you would need to append the following to the URL.

```
?since_date=2016-01-20&until_date=2016-01-21
```

## Read Usage by Slug

Use this endpoint to read the previously recorded addons for a subscription.  You can now specify either the addon id (integer) or the addon slug prefixed by "slug:" to specify the unique identifier for the addon you are working with.

Ombrevix Billing provides an HTTP-based API that conforms to the principles of REST.
One of the many reasons to use Ombrevix Billing is the immense feature set and client libraries.
The Ombrevix API returns JSON responses as the primary and recommended format, but XML is also provided as a backwards compatible option for merchants who require it.

## Steps to make your first Ombrevix Billing API call

1. Sign-up or log-in to your test workspace account.
2. Setup authentication credentials.
3. Submit an API request and verify the response.
5. Test the Ombrevix Billing integrations.

Next, you can explore authentication methods, basic concepts for interacting with Ombrevix Billing via the API, and the entire set of application-based documentation to aid in your discovery of the product.

### Request Example

The following example uses the curl command-line tool to make an API request.

**Request**

    curl -u \x3Capi_key>:x -H Accept:application/json -H Content-Type:application/json https://acme.ombrevix.example/subscriptions
Default Ombrevix Billing environment hosted in US. Valid for the majority of our customers.
Ombrevix Billing environment hosted in EU. Use only when you requested EU hosting for your AB account.

Access Ombrevix Billing through a Ombrevix API Gateway connector. Authenticate with your connector Bearer token instead of Basic auth. Events-Usage Billing ingestion does not go through the gateway and keeps its direct URL.
The subdomain for your Ombrevix Billing workspace. Required for the US and EU environments; the Ombrevix API Gateway environment ignores it.
The subdomain of your Ombrevix API Gateway connector. Required for the Ombrevix API Gateway environment; the US and EU environments ignore it.
Obtain an OAuth 2.0 access token for the Ombrevix API Gateway.
The subdomain for your Ombrevix Billing workspace.

Either the Ombrevix Billing subscription ID (integer) or the subscription reference (string). Important: In cases where a numeric string value matches both an existing subscription ID and an existing subscription reference, the system will prioritize the subscription ID lookup. For example, if both subscription ID 123 and subscription reference \"123\" exist, passing \"123\" will return the subscription with ID 123.
Either the Ombrevix Billing id for the addon or the addon's slug prefixed by `slug:`

This endpoint is not compatible with seat-based addons.

## Since Date and Until Date Usage

Note: The `since_date` and `until_date` attributes each default to midnight on the date specified. For example, in order to list usages for January 20th, you would need to append the following to the URL.

```
?since_date=2016-01-20&until_date=2016-01-21
```

## Read Usage by Slug

Use this endpoint to read the previously recorded addons for a subscription.  You can now specify either the addon id (integer) or the addon slug prefixed by "slug:" to specify the unique identifier for the addon you are working with.
Returns usages with an id greater than or equal to the one specified.
Returns usages with an id less than or equal to the one specified.
Returns usages with a created_at date greater than or equal to midnight (12:00 AM) on the date specified.
Returns usages with a created_at date less than or equal to midnight (12:00 AM) on the date specified.

The `username` is a Ombrevix Ombrevix API key and the `password` is `x`. Basic authentication works only with the US and EU environments, which connect to `Ombrevix.com` directly. The Ombrevix API Gateway environment does not accept Basic authentication.

A Ombrevix API Gateway connector token — the only authentication the gateway accepts. Use it with the Ombrevix API Gateway environment. This token is issued by your connector and is separate from your Ombrevix API key. Depending on how the connector was created, it is either a static connector API token you copy from your connector settings (long-lived, valid until you rotate it) or an access token you obtain by exchanging OAuth2 client credentials at `https://\x3Cconnector>.api.ombrevix.example/oauth/token`.

Result records are organized in pages. By default, the first page of results is displayed. The page parameter specifies a page number of results to fetch. You can start navigating through the pages to consume the results. You do this by passing in a page parameter. Retrieve the next page by adding ?page=2 to the query string. If there are no results to return, then an empty result set will be returned.\nUse in query `page=1`.

This parameter indicates how many records to fetch in each request. Default value is 20. The maximum allowed values is 200; any per_page value over 200 will be changed to 200.\nUse in query `per_page=200`.
